verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows no public API reference or runnable examples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The HRIS integration and llms.txt are adjacent features, not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
